bugs.summary: The Labels menu stayed open after two Escape presses, and the Assignees menu stayed open after two Escape presses; only a mouse click outside closes them. While open they cover the Milestone, Projects and Assignees rows, so a keyboard-only user cannot get out of the menu. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/new)
bugs.expected: Pressing Escape closes the open dropdown menu, as it does for the Milestone menu on the same page (Escape closed that one immediately).
bugs.actual: The Labels menu stayed open after two Escape presses, and the Assignees menu stayed open after two Escape presses; only a mouse click outside closes them. While open they cover the Milestone, Projects and Assignees rows, so a keyboard-only user cannot get out of the menu.

bugs.name: Timeline of the blocking issue says "added a new dependency #15" while its sidebar says "Blocks #15"
bugs.summary: The same page says both things: the timeline at the top reads "eval added a new dependency" followed by "+ #15 agent7-dep-alpha", while the sidebar panel "Blocks" on the right lists "#15 agent7-dep-alpha". The timeline entry copies the wording of the dependent side, so on the blocking issue it states the opposite direction of the relation shown in the sidebar of the same page. Seen the same way on #1 after #4 was made to depend on it (timeline "added a new dependency + #4 Review the release ownership proposal", sidebar "Blocks #4"). (on /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/17)
bugs.expected: The timeline entry on the blocking issue should state the relation in its real direction (that the other issue was made to depend on this one), the same direction as the "Blocks" section of the sidebar; it should not read as if this issue had just been given a new dependency.
bugs.actual: The same page says both things: the timeline at the top reads "eval added a new dependency" followed by "+ #15 agent7-dep-alpha", while the sidebar panel "Blocks" on the right lists "#15 agent7-dep-alpha". The timeline entry copies the wording of the dependent side, so on the blocking issue it states the opposite direction of the relation shown in the sidebar of the same page. Seen the same way on #1 after #4 was made to depend on it (timeline "added a new dependency + #4 Review the release ownership proposal", sidebar "Blocks #4").
